description: search the anne black catalogue by words (name, sku, colour, description), colour, category or max price. returns products with price, stock status, url and image. for products with variants, call get_product to see colours/sizes.

color.description: filter by glaze colour name, e.g. "mustard", "white", "dusty blue"

max_price.description: max (lowest) price in the store currency

query.description: search words, e.g. "knob mat", "bloom vase", "earrings". all words must match. english works in every store.

store.description: store code: com (english, EUR — default), dk (danish, DKK), or a language code de, fr, nl, sv, it, es, pl, pt, fi, cs, sk, hu, ro, bg, el, hr, sl, et, lv, lt (EUR)

name: search_products
title: search products
